Use this when the app, rather than the agent, decides what may be kept: for example when the end user has to consent to being recorded before anything about the call can be stored. The value stays in effect until the client sends a different one, so it only needs to be sent when the answer changes. It covers the agent's side of the turn as well as the end user's. Turns that complete before the client first sends this are recorded according to the app's logging settings, as though the field did not exist.
